summary: The menu (as of 2026-11-10, 49 names, every F-score fully computable at 9 of 9) is led by VRSN, DPZ, CARG, TPR and IDXX: top-decile in-sector gross profitability, F-score 8-9 and operating cash flow above net income. The ten equity holdings named in the learning file (WMT, KR, DPZ, IDXX, CARG, INCY, FAST, VRSN, MSCI, EXEL) all still pass the screen. The main accounting concerns are DORM (cash flow well below earnings), the amended filings at GRMN and ONC, and stale fiscal years at CLX and the September filers. No lesson names this role and I have no graded calls yet. L3 (written for the proposer and PM) shaped how I treat sector labels: DPZ's #1 Staples rank and the MSCI/MCO/FAST/MSM labels are read as SIC artifacts, not as sector evidence.
